descriptionChirho: Lattice-work or checker-work netting used as architectural ornamentation on the capitals of the Temple pillars (1 Kings 7, 2 Kings 25, 2 Chronicles 4, Jeremiah 52).
A latticed window screen or grating through which one looks out, as in the scene of Sisera's mother peering through the window (Judges 5:28).
A net or mesh used metaphorically as a trap or snare into which the wicked stumble (Job 18:8).
